title: The Power of Yet
sections: A young student stared at a tricky math problem. Her mind went blank. 'I can't do this,' she whispered.
Her teacher overheard and smiled gently. 'You can't do it YET,' she said.
'Yet means you're learning,' she explained. 'Like a seed growing into a tree.'
The student tried again. Slowly, numbers started making sense. She felt a spark.
From that day, 'yet' became her favorite word. It reminded her: with time, she could do anything.

title: Comma Saves Lives
sections: A hungry student wrote an essay. In it: 'Let's eat grandma'.
The teacher read it and gasped. 'Oh no! Cannibalism?'
She added a comma: 'Let's eat, grandma'.
Grandma was safe. Punctuation saved the day!
Moral: commas matter (literally).

title: The Tree of Thoughts
sections: Imagine a tree with many branches. Each branch is a thought.
Some branches are beautiful (like 'be kind'). Some are messy (like 'I'm late').
A wise gardener prunes messy branches daily. What thoughts will you prune today?
With practice, your mind becomes a peaceful garden.

title: The Curious Coin
sections: You have 3 coins: 1 is fake (lighter).
Find the fake coin in 1 weighing.
Think: how would you do it?
Weigh 2 coins. If one’s lighter, it’s fake. If balanced, the 3rd is fake.

title: Procrastination Party
sections: Procrastination threw a party. Friends came: Distraction, Netflix, Sleep.
They danced all night. Next morning… deadlines didn’t care.
Moral: parties end, deadlines don’t.

title: Small Wins Add Up
sections: Imagine climbing a mountain. One step at a time.
Small wins build big achievements.
Consistency > perfection.

title: The Missing Puzzle Piece
sections: A puzzle had 1 piece missing.
Everyone searched. The answer was simple: it was under the rug.
Sometimes solutions are right where you least expect.

title: Mistakes Are Fuel
sections: A student failed a test. 'I’m bad at math,' he thought.
But his teacher said, 'Mistakes fuel progress.'
He tried again, smarter each time.
